title: Network adapter is off
symptoms: no internet at all, wifi icon off, cable unplugged, not connected
fix: Turn Wi-Fi on or reconnect the cable, then check again.

title: Can't reach the router
symptoms: connected to wifi but nothing works, router not responding, weak signal
fix: Restart the router, move closer to it, or reconnect to the right network.

title: Router is fine but the internet is down
symptoms: connected to wifi, no internet, nothing loads, provider outage
fix: Restart the modem and router. If it is still down, the internet provider is likely having an outage.

title: DNS failure
symptoms: connected but websites won't load, pages fail to open, apps work by address
fix: Change the DNS servers (for example to the router or 1.1.1.1), or restart the router.

title: The connection itself is fine
symptoms: one website or app is slow or broken while everything else works
fix: The network checks out. The problem is probably the specific app or website; try restarting it or checking its status page.
